description: Selection inside the body of a visible post resolves to the post and hides exactly that post behind one recoverable placeholder.
Selection inside a bait comment resolves to the comment element; the innocent parent post stays visible and gets no placeholder.
Selection in page chrome outside any post (footer/sidebar) resolves to no container: visible failure, zero mutations.
Menu invoked with an empty selection: no-selection failure, clipboard/storage/counters untouched, nothing hidden.
Selection anchored in a comment-draft contenteditable box is rejected: reporting or hiding draft text makes no sense.
Explicit manual action hides a post whose text is allowlisted without mutating the allow rule or any other preference.
A target restored via Show (forceShow + cooldown) is re-hidden only by a new explicit manual click; the click clears only that element's protection.
An automatic rescan that flags a shown target must leave it visible; only an explicit manual action may override Show protection.
Hiding an already hidden target (manual duplicate, or an auto-hidden target reached through stale DOM) adds no second placeholder and changes no attribution or counters.
A detached anchor (selection in a removed node) is a no-op; a recreated replacement node (same data-id, new identity) is visible again by design — manual state is identity-keyed and never persisted.
